<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Verdicts are only worth something at a final head. Tonight the PM checked finality by hand, and got it wrong once. This plan encodes the check as one read-only command. One coder (tapir).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- `just pr-freeze <pr>` verifies a PR head is final (remote and gh agree, main base, CLEAN, CI passed, ready, migration numbered above main, Delivers parses) before verdicts are requested or READY is sent.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Any daemon or CI-gate change; this is a hand-run harness tool.
- Merging or pushing anything.

<a id="acceptance-criteria"></a>

## Acceptance criteria

| id | claim | state | note | receipt | pressure | proven_by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ac-0001 | One command says whether a PR head is final for verdicts. `just pr-freeze &lt;pr&gt;` (a script under harness/scripts with a just recipe; read-only; gh and git only) prints, for the PR: the head from `git ls-remote origin refs/pull/&lt;n&gt;/head` and from `gh pr view`, and whether they agree; the base branch and whether it is main; mergeStateStatus (CLEAN, DIRTY, BEHIND, UNSTABLE) with the reason; each CI check's latest run by name (an older failed run superseded by a newer pass counts as pass, an in-progress one as not final); draft or ready; and whether a review worktree exists at exactly that head (`git worktree list` for a path ending in -&lt;pr&gt;-&lt;head7&gt;, at that commit). It exits 0 and says FINAL only when the two heads agree, the base is main, the state is CLEAN, every check's latest run passed, and the PR is not draft; otherwise it exits non-zero naming each failing condition and the next step (merge main, wait for CI, mark ready). | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0001](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0002 | Tonight's other freeze lessons are checked too. It reports each migration the PR adds (crates/store/migrations) against main's highest and SCHEMA_VERSION on both sides, and flags a number not above main's highest (the merge-order rule, 07 Nov). It parses the PR body's Delivers: line with the same parser CI uses and flags prose or a missing line. With --worktree it creates the detached review worktree at the verified head if none exists and prints its path. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0002](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0003 | Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). No daemon change. Run by hand, once per verdict request: one ls-remote, two or three gh calls, a few local git reads. No loop, timer or poll. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0003](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0004 | Docs and states. The pij skill's PM and verdict sections say to run `just pr-freeze &lt;pr&gt;` before requesting verdicts and before sending READY; AGENTS.md's harness tooling list names it; docs/difficulties.md marks F92 resolved. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0004](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

F92 (offered by reviewer pij-double-bobcat, 07 Nov): on 07 Nov, #149's head moved four times under review (642e64b, a63edce, fb87062, a force-push that landed for a minute) and pm-001 repointed seats on a coder's report of a push that hadn't stuck; #136, #148 and #150 went DIRTY after merges and #152's migration order was mis-stated. Each was caught by hand with ls-remote, gh pr view and CI reads. The merge-order migration rule and the Delivers check (plan 209) already exist; this puts them in front of the verdict request.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
